source.name: Sports Business Journal: Revolution sign Gillette as new kit sponsor
source.quote: Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed (BOSTON BUSINESS JOURNAL, 2/11). The partnership runs through the 2031 MLS season.
source.note: No value was reported; the field is null because the terms were not disclosed.

note: Gillette became the Revolution's front-of-jersey sponsor in 2025, replacing UnitedHealthcare, the club's front sponsor since 2011.
